title: Structure-Switching DNA Translators for the Integration of Transcription Factor-Driven CRISPR-Cas12a Activity into Synthetic Biomolecular Networks
authors: Luca Capelli; Sofia Marzari; Elena Spezzani; Alessandro Bertucci
one_liner_zh: 该文利用TF结合调控DNA构象开关以控制CRISPR-Cas12a活性，虽涉及TF-DNA互作但侧重合成生物网络工程应用，非结合机制建模，方法上无AI或物理模拟，故为中档匹配。
abstract: CRISPR-CAS systems have advanced many domains in life sciences, enabling diverse applications in gene editing, diagnostics, and biosensing. Here, we introduce a platform that leverages transcription factors (TFs) to regulate CRISPR-Cas12a trans-cleavage activity via engineered DNA translators. These dynamic DNA structures respond to TF binding by switching conformations, modulating Cas12a activity. Using TATA-binding protein (TBP) and Myc-Max as TF models, we optimized DNA translators for precise and tunable control with rapid response kinetics. We demonstrated the platform’s specificity and versatility by integrating TF-induced regulation into synthetic biology networks, including the activation of a fluorogenic RNA aptamer (Mango III) and the creation of an artificial multimolecular communication pathway between Cas12a and Cas13a. This work establishes TFs as effective regulators of CRISPR-Cas systems, enabling novel protein-nucleic acid communication channels, showing potential for novels synthetic biology applications.
abstract_zh: CRISPR-CAS系统推动了生命科学多个领域的发展，实现了基因编辑、诊断和生物传感中的多样化应用。在此，我们介绍一个平台，该平台利用转录因子（TFs）通过工程化DNA转换器来调控CRISPR-Cas12a的反式切割活性。这些动态DNA结构通过响应TF结合而切换构象，从而调节Cas12a活性。以TATA结合蛋白（TBP）和Myc-Max作为TF模型，我们优化了DNA转换器，以实现精确且可调的调控，并具备快速响应动力学。我们通过将TF诱导的调控整合到合成生物学网络中，包括激活荧光RNA适配体（Mango III）和构建Cas12a与Cas13a之间的人工多分子通信通路，展示了该平台的特异性和多功能性。这项工作确立了TFs作为CRISPR-Cas系统的有效调控因子，开辟了新型蛋白质-核酸通信渠道，显示出在新型合成生物学应用中的潜力。
